scope: offline post-fix review of the exact source-allocation zero-queue lifecycle, typed teardown persistence, lifecycle commitments, destination freshness, and movement-accounting isolation
summary: The strengthened worker consumes the production zero-queue exactly once only after the exact topology, allocator lifetimes, pre-release ownership snapshot, canonical capture and manifest commitment exist. The production EXPORT_CAPTURE gate is authenticated before and after the destructive read. Any malformed, missing, duplicate, unrelated, zeroing-mode, API, or gate condition raises typed V11RuntimeTeardownRequired evidence and cannot publish a successful micro result. Queue evidence is persisted as source-lifecycle metadata and is not included in StatePassRecord movement totals.

production_gate_binding.evidence: require_production_export_gate_v11 authenticates the actual scheduler, manager, gate binding and EXPORT_CAPTURE operation both immediately before and immediately after the destructive drain.

safe_order.evidence: The drain occurs inside the same EXPORT_CAPTURE critical section after authenticated ownership/capture and before release. No engine step occurs between drain and release.

exact_queue_identity.evidence: Expected and observed IDs must be strict non-boolean nonnegative integers, length 1,152, duplicate-free and set-equal. Ordering is normalized only for deterministic SHA-256 commitment. The production take_new_block_ids method is invoked exactly once.

attention_only_zeroing_mode.evidence: The source drain is permitted only when scheduler.needs_kv_cache_zeroing is exactly False. Missing, true or ambiguous zeroing mode requires typed runtime teardown.

commitments: expected and observed sorted source block-ID SHA-256
sorted source (block ID, allocator epoch) lifetime SHA-256
production gate ID, binding ID and operation
lifecycle_commitments.evidence: All three external commitments must be lowercase 64-hex values before the queue can be read. Successful evidence is persisted under source_allocations.allocation_zero_queue beside the independent lifetime and ownership commitments.

typed_destructive_failure.evidence: Every precondition and post-read mismatch raises V11RuntimeTeardownRequired. After a destructive read, evidence records destructive_drain_performed, expected/observed counts and hashes, missing/unexpected/duplicate IDs, affected IDs and passed=false. Worker main persists the typed error and teardown evidence identically to failure.json and result.json with status=failed; no success result is possible.

post_free_integrity.evidence: The existing release_source_and_prove_v11 proof remains immediately after the drain and must prove all 1,152 source lifetimes tombstoned, allocator-available and inaccessible before export success.

fresh_destination_validation.evidence: Import behavior is unchanged: it first rejects any residual queue, each fresh allocation drains and validates its own exact subset, epoch proofs cover the current destination map, the final queue must be empty, and source/destination (block ID, epoch) lifetimes must be disjoint before continuation.

movement_accounting_isolation.evidence: The queue operation emits no StatePassRecord and declares no logical, physical, external or temporary bytes. all_passes remains exactly captured.state_passes plus restore_passes; movement, export_movement and restore_movement are computed solely from those canonical records before queue metadata is serialized separately. No double count or unmeasured traffic is introduced.

failure_b_provenance.evidence: Attempt exp004-v11-micro-s41-b failed closed on the preexisting restore queue, produced no successful result, settled 155.17 A100-seconds, and left provider cleanup clean. It is retained as causal evidence for this narrowly scoped lifecycle fix.

covered_adversarial_cases: arbitrary-order exact queue and exactly-one read
empty, missing, duplicate, equal-cardinality foreign and extra IDs
typed teardown evidence persistence without success

constraints: Use this fix only for the exact 1,152-full-page micro transaction and only with needs_kv_cache_zeroing exactly false.
Reseal the attempt configuration and offline manifest against every reviewed current hash before any invocation.
Treat any typed queue teardown as terminal for that runtime; never continue to import or publish measurement.
Keep queue lifecycle evidence outside canonical StatePassRecord byte totals.
Retain the existing import preflight, per-subset drain, epoch validation, final-empty-queue and source/destination lifetime-disjointness gates.
decision: PASS: the strengthened source-allocation queue lifecycle is fail-closed, provenance-bound, physically accounting-neutral, and preserves the existing fresh-destination integrity path.
